properties.text: I was privileged to see him play Prospero in The Tempest at the Public Theater in NYC in '95. His command of Shakespeare was unparalleled. I met him so many times in the early '90s at NYC cons, he was a pretty nice guy despite the fact I was never the biggest Star Trek fan. 

He also was funny if you caught him in the right mood at panels. :3

I saw Patrick Stewart as Scrooge in A Christmas Carol at the Winter Garden Theater in NYC as a kid. Didn't realize it at the time, but probably one of the coolest things I ever got to do. RIP to an absolute legend.

Sad, sad news. My wife & I saw him onstage as Macbeth at the BAM Harvey Theater in Brooklyn in 2008. Brilliant performance. The production was later filmed (elsewhere) & is available on PBS. My precarious mortality is shoved at me lately, nearly daily. RIP, Sir Patrick. He was one of the greats.

I was privileged to see Patrick Stewart on stage once. Macbeth at the Brooklyn Academy of Music. An amazing contemporary styled production with a minimalist set. I vividly remember one scene, a monologue by Stewart as Macbeth as he made and ate a sandwich. He made it look so natural and real.
